title: Verify freshness before summarizing a scheduled research brief
context: Synthetic public scenario: a dated brief may exist even when its enrichment step is stale or degraded.

execution_map.terminal_state: The next brief is accepted only when its source time and processing status are explicit.
phase_path: retain raw output when enrichment is degraded
execution_map.current_batch: Wait for the next scheduled artifact.

acceptance: The artifact reports source time and generation time.
Missing or stale enrichment is marked degraded rather than hidden.
The owner receives a verification receipt.

next_action: Wait for the next scheduled artifact, then verify freshness before summarizing it.

trigger.promote: A new dated brief is written.
